sections.title: Building Complex Technical Attributes Before the Noun
sections.content: In Hungarian journalistic and patent prose, an -andó/-endő participle can govern its own adverbials of place, time, or means, all packed neatly between the definite article (a/az) and the head noun: 'a sürgősen nyomdába küldendő cikkek' (the articles to be sent urgently to the printing house); 'az acélgolyó útján papírra felviendő festék' (the ink to be applied to paper by way of the steel ball).

sections.title: Irregular -v- Stem Participles (teendő, viendő, veendő)
sections.content: Pay special attention to the small group of monosyllabic verbs whose stems alternate with -v- (tesz 'does/puts', visz 'carries', vesz 'takes/buys', eszik 'eats', iszik 'drinks', lesz 'will be'). Their obligatory participles are formed from the short vowel stem: teendő ('thing to be done / task'), felviendő ('to be applied/carried up'), figyelembe veendő ('to be taken into consideration'), elérendő ('to be achieved'). Notice that teendő has also lexicalized as a standalone noun ('sok a teendőnk' = we have a lot to do)!

sections.title: Regular and -v- Stem Obligatory Participles
rows: a sürgősen nyomdába küldendő cikkek (articles to be sent to press)
a kiküszöbölendő műszaki hiba (the technical flaw to be eliminated)
a legfontosabb teendők listája (the list of most important tasks to be done)
a tervezésnél figyelembe veendő légnyomás (air pressure to be taken into account)

items.spanish: Hosszú percekig kellett szárítgatni a sürgősen nyomdába küldendő cikkeket.
items.english: One had to blot for long minutes the articles to be sent urgently to the printing press.

items.spanish: A nagy magasságban figyelembe veendő alacsony légnyomás sem okozott szivárgást.
items.english: Even the low air pressure to be taken into consideration at high altitude caused no leakage.

items.spanish: Bíró László a testvére segítségével kísérletezte ki a megfelelő viszkozitású pasztát.
items.english: László Bíró developed the paste of proper viscosity with the help of his brother.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Remember the fixed idiom 'figyelembe veendő tényező' ('a factor to be taken into account')—it is one of the most frequent B2–C1 academic collocations in Hungarian!
